name: Ampara Kayak & Canoe
description: Ampara Kayak & Canoe, nestled in the Ampara district of Sri Lanka, offers kayaking adventures along the river, paddling through nature trails, and serene nature walks. The park stands as a testament to the rich recreational opportunities available in the area, attracting both locals and tourists seeking a close connection with the natural environment. Its location near the river provides an ideal setting for these activities, showcasing the beauty of the region’s waterways and forests. Established over a decade ago, the facility has grown into a popular spot for outdoor enthusiasts, offering a unique way to experience the local culture and natural landscapes.

name: Lahugala Elephant Safari
description: Lahugala Elephant Safari, an adventurous park in Ampara, Sri Lanka, offers visitors the chance to interact with elephants through guided tours and educational talks. The site, once part of ancient royal lands, now serves as a sanctuary for rescued elephants, providing a unique experience where tourists can learn about these gentle giants and their conservation. Notable for its commitment to animal welfare and eco-tourism, Lahugala Elephant Safari attracts nature lovers and animal enthusiasts seeking a memorable encounter with these magnificent creatures.
activities: Elephant Interaction, Guided Tours, Educational Talks

name: Deegawapi Heritage Trek
description: The Deegawapi Heritage Trek is an adventurous park nestled in the Ampara district of Sri Lanka, offering visitors the chance to explore ancient ruins, hike through lush forests, and witness cascading waterfalls. The area was once a stronghold of the ancient Jaffna Kingdom, with remnants of its past visible in the well-preserved temples and fortifications scattered throughout the landscape. Notable events include the British colonial era's efforts to develop the region, which left their mark in the form of colonial-era buildings and infrastructure. Today, the trek offers a unique blend of natural beauty and historical intrigue, attracting both nature lovers and history enthusiasts.
activities: Explore ancient ruins, Hike through lush forests, Witness waterfalls
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep
